title: Sunset at Rincón Beach Villa
description: The Spanish architecture and Moroccan decor create one the most characterful stays in Rincón. Beautiful gardens and ocean views, your own private plunge pool, breathtaking infinity pool overlooking the Ocean, beach access and peaceful environment make it the perfect place for the discerning travelers looking to unwind but still have close by access to outdoor adventures including water-sports, mountain biking, art, culinary experiences, local markets and shopping scene around town.The spaceSolecito Luxury Villa at the world renowned Horned Dorset Primavera is a 2-story, one bedroom and 2 bathrooms offer exquisite details include sprawling marble and stucco spaces, keyhole archways, ornate area rugs, surrounded by impecable landscaping help craft a sense of place that mosts guests cherish.The main living space opens to its patio where you can find your private plunge pool and seating area overlooking a tropical garden.The master suite is located on the second level of the villa. King size 4 poster mahogany bed and hand-carved furniture on the sitting area. High ceilings and 2 double cedar doors open up for spectacular ocean and mountain views and the sound of singing roosters. The grand suite has a luxurious bathroom covered from floor to ceiling with white Carrara marble, a beautiful freestanding white porcelain bathtub for 2, shower and His & Hers sinks. The complex offers a full-size generator & water tank in case of an interruption in electrical or water service.Guest accessFor your convenience we have lockboxes for self check-in.Other things to noteThis villa for up to 4 guests also features an equipped kitchenette with microwave, coffee machine, blender, fridge and kitchenware. Eugenio Maria de Hostos airport is within 0.5 km. and BQN in Aguadilla is a 40 minute drive. Rincon is located at a 2 1/2 hour drive from San Juan SJU airport.
amenities: Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, infinity

title: Private pool Suite with outdoor tub for couples
description: Escape to your own private retreat in the heart of Rincón, Puerto Rico. This 1-bedroom apartment combines comfort and relaxation with modern design and tropical charm.Unwind in your private plunge pool or soak under the sky in the outdoor freestanding tub.Perfect for couples or solo travelers, just minutes away from Rincón’s famous beaches, surfing spots, and vibrant dining scene. Reservations are confirmed in acknowledgement that the interruption of these services caused by the provider will not result in the termination of the reservation or any type of refunds.Other this to note:We spray for bugs with a professional on a regularly basis but please have in mind that the suite is in a forest area and the space is created in a inside/outside space which still might have bugs in a natural forest setting.Important: RESERVATIONS IN MAY AND JUNE IN PUERTO RICO THERES A NATURAL PHENOMENON. We left all the lights off because the first couple of hard rains in May and June every year makes termites in the trees hatch, these fly all over the island and are attracted by light. It's very difficult to predict when they are going to hatch. THIS HAPPENS EVERYWHERE IN PUERTO RICO, you can be in a restaurant, the airbnb or any place in the island.There’s no way to exterminate them as they are in almost every three in Puerto Rico and attracted by light. They are harmless but a pain to clean.They fly during the night of a very hard rain, it is VERY IMPORTANT that you leave all the LIGHTS OFF inside the apartment when you leave or while you are in there because these flying termites will come in. title: Oceanfront Penthouse | Rincon | Stunning Views
description: Welcome to your private oceanfront escape. This studio offers an open floor plan, breathtaking panoramic views, and the soothing sound of the waves just beyond your terrace.Step outside onto the large private terrace—your front-row seat to the Caribbean Sea. title: Luxury Ocean View Condo steps from the beach..
description: In the ♥ of downtown Rincon - Luxury - Gated - 4th Floor Ocean View Condo with Private Patio and Pool. · Steps from the Rincon’s best public beach and only a quick 5 minute walk from the ♥ of downtown. · Comfortably sleeps 6 (King Bed, 2 day beds that sleep 3 total, and a pull out couch) · Washer/dryer and everything you need to cook for large families. This condo is sure to meet all your vacation needs!The spaceRincon is known as the surfing capital of the Caribbean – Corona Fest (Surf Pro Competition) takes place here annually and is something you shouldn’t miss out on.You can walk to virtually everything you need during your stay. This complex is closest to Rincon's best swimming beach (Balneario Rincon) and is steps from the condo. If you need groceries you can buy them at the Plaza or there's a good close by supermarket that offers a free ride from the plaza for your convenience.The plaza is less than 5 minutes away (walking) and you can enjoy all the restaurants and Rincon’s Central Plaza and it’s colorful activities. (It is the perfect distance to walk, but far enough to not be bothered by any of the potential noise from the evening activities.)In Rincon, you can find:• The Harbour is the closest place to grab dinner cocktails (best sunset in the West)• La Cambija (Seafood Restaurant) is the second closest to the condo and is a 3 minute walk.• El Faro – Lighthouse • La Plaza Rincon Weekly Sunday farmers market Weekly Thursday night artwalk (Local artisan fair, great place to buy touristy things you won't be ashamed of. Artwalk goes from 4 - 10pm with drinks and dancing lasting until midnight) Isla Restaurant, Rincon (Brunch is amazing) Rincon Beer Co - Locally brewed craft beers, great food, live music. Dulcis Vita - Coffee, Cupcakes, food, WiFi Das Alpen - Authentic German food & more Uncharted Studios - Local screenprinting studio Ocean State of Mind - Locally made jewelry & art The Green Thumb Grill - Healthy with vegan options Cafe 413 - Breakfast and a bar open at night, lots of fresh healthy options Panaderia Rincoena - Famous panaderia (bakery) with authentic local pastries for your delight• Other places in the “Puntas” section of Rincon Tamboo Restaurant and Bar Calypso Café and Surf ShopCome visit the most beautiful side The West Coast of Puerto• 10 minutes to Restaurante Kaplash (Seafood) - Anasaco• 20 minutes from one of the most beautiful beaches in Puerto Rico (Crash Boat)• 20 minutes from Las Cascadas (Waterpark)• 20 minutes to The Old Aguadilla Lighthouse Ruins• 30 minutes from Aguadilla (BQN) airport • 30 minutes to Mayguez Casino• 1 hour from La Parguera (Bioiluminescent Bay- a must see)• 1.5 hours to La Cueva de Camuy (Spelunkers Dream – over 200 caves)• 1.5 hours to Arecibo Observatory (From the movie “Contact” and The World’s Largest Radar/Radio telescope) and The Cueva Ventana (over a million year old cave) • 1.5 hours Gilligan’s Island (Cayo Aurora) a tiny islant that is part of the Biosphere Rreserve of Guanica• 2 hours from El Yunque (Puerto Rico’s Rainforest)• 2.5 hours from San Juan (SJU) airport• 2.5 hours from Toro Verde (Extreme Zipline- Ecological Park) in Orocovis• 2 hours to Cuomo (P.R’s Natural Hot Springs)Breweries/Distilleries• 30 minutes to Medallia• 1.5 hours Don Q (Serralles Distillery)• 2.5 hours - Barardi• 2.5 hours- Hacienda Santa Ana (Home of Ron del Barrilito)Coffee Farms• 1.5 hours Sandra Coffee Farm (Adjuntas)• 1.5 hours to Haciend de Café PomarrosaGuest accessEntire CondoOther things to noteDon't wantto rent a car?
